name: Sunflower Oil
siboNotes: Pure oils are FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated in SIBO, though some may find high-fat foods slow digestion.
preparationTips: Use for high-heat cooking as it has a neutral flavor
Store in cool, dark place to prevent rancidity
Choose cold-pressed varieties when possible for better nutrient retention
Measure portions as fats are calorie-dense
